public_scholarly_sources.title: Proving the pressing game conjecture on linear graphs

uses.theorem_4_printed_page_47: Pressability existence only, imported through the terminal-coordinate theorem. It applies to arbitrary finite bicolored graphs with a black vertex in every connected component; isolated white vertices are ignored.
uses.conjecture_6_printed_page_47: Original LCS-at-least-rank-minus-four normalization: at most four deletions and at most four insertions.

inspection.precise_scope: Pressability existence for arbitrary finite bicolored graphs with a black vertex in every connected component. Deleting isolated white vertices gives the variant used by the audited note.
